The cluster is bipartite, so the gauge c_i -> (-1)^i c_i takes t = -1 to t = 1 and leaves t' and t'' (same-sublattice hops): t' = 0.3, t'' = -0.2 in the form -t' sum - t'' sum. Convention check: at half filling the source prints E00 = -11.329720 (Table I caption, sources/cond-mat-0508035.txt line 65); with J = 0.3 and -n_i n_j / 4 on the 64 bonds this is 0.3 (E_S.S - 16), so E_S.S / 32 = -0.6801792, the 32-site Heisenberg energy per site -0.680179 printed by Schulz, Ziman & Poilblanc (arXiv:cond-mat/9402061 Table II, J2 = 0.00, column 32; sources/cond-mat-9402061.txt line 1642). Without the -n_i n_j / 4 term E00 would be -6.53.
